limits: One qualitative reviewer; scores are judgments rather than objective measurements.
Only supplied full-page desktop and mobile screenshots were inspected; interactions, focus states, accessibility semantics, dynamic content and other viewport widths are excluded.
Full-page previews are downscaled by the viewer, limiting judgments about very small text.
No source code, routing, evaluation results or identifying metadata were inspected.

hierarchy.strength: A/lighting-index-1440.png: large serif headline, adjacent installation image and dark collection CTA establish a clear reading order. A/lighting-planner-1440.png: empty state and estimate are visually distinct.
hierarchy.weakness: A/lighting-planner-375.png: estimate precedes the empty selection, giving the zero total prominence before the next action.

art_direction.strength: A/lighting-index-1440.png: warm stone, bronze photography and cream background form a coherent architectural mood.
art_direction.weakness: A/lighting-index-1440.png: the same material-study image appears twice; A/lighting-collection-1440.png: simple rendered product shapes feel less rich than the installation photography.

typography_spacing.strength: A/lighting-collection-1440.png: strong serif titles, restrained metadata and aligned specification rules make the cards easy to scan.
typography_spacing.weakness: A/lighting-index-375.png: header and image captions are visually very small; uppercase microcopy is more demanding to read.

responsive_composition.strength: A/lighting-collection-375.png: three cards stack cleanly with prices, specifications and paired buttons contained in each card.
responsive_composition.weakness: A/lighting-index-375.png: navigation is compressed into the right side of a narrow header instead of gaining a dedicated row.

professional_finish.strength: A/lighting-planner-1440.png: crisp borders, consistent alignment and a designed empty state; A/lighting-collection-375.png: complete card/footer rhythm.
professional_finish.weakness: A/lighting-planner-1440.png: substantial unoccupied space below the short empty-state content makes the page feel sparse.

hierarchy.strength: A/expedition-index-1440.png: bold two-line hero and cyan CTA are unmistakable; A/expedition-builder-1440.png: planning inputs and day-by-day content form clear columns.
hierarchy.weakness: A/expedition-journeys-1440.png: repeated terrain/duration/price metadata within each route creates some unnecessary scanning work.

art_direction.strength: A/expedition-index-1440.png: dramatic alpine/fjord photography and navy/cyan palette establish a distinctive outdoor identity.
art_direction.weakness: A/expedition-index-1440.png and A/expedition-journeys-1440.png: flat geometric desert image has noticeably less landscape information and richness than the other two route images.

typography_spacing.strength: A/expedition-builder-1440.png: large sans headings, serif narrative text and ruled sections create a legible editorial structure.
typography_spacing.weakness: A/expedition-index-375.png and A/expedition-journeys-375.png: very small header navigation and metadata contrast with much larger headings.

responsive_composition.strength: A/expedition-builder-375.png: full-width fields and stacked itinerary sections remain contained, with no visible content overlap.
responsive_composition.weakness: A/expedition-index-375.png: four header items remain on a single tightly packed row; A/expedition-builder-375.png: route heading breaks into two heavy lines, pushing controls farther down.

professional_finish.strength: A/expedition-journeys-1440.png: route rows and image widths align consistently; A/expedition-builder-375.png: form, estimate and day sections retain a coherent border system.
professional_finish.weakness: A/expedition-index-1440.png: geometric desert panel and repeated metadata make the route section feel less editorially resolved than the hero.

hierarchy.strength: B/lighting-index-1440.png: oversized serif/italic headline leads into a wide installation image; B/lighting-planner-1440.png: selection and shaded summary/form panel are clearly separated.
hierarchy.weakness: B/lighting-planner-375.png: the large repeated installation image lies between the empty selection and summary, lengthening the path to the form.

art_direction.strength: B/lighting-index-1440.png: copper italic accents, warm dining-room image and material study create a polished, cohesive identity.
art_direction.weakness: B/lighting-collection-1440.png: flat product diagrams communicate silhouettes but provide less material detail than the lifestyle photography.

typography_spacing.strength: B/lighting-collection-1440.png: serif product names, restrained sans body copy and consistent card baselines are balanced. B/lighting-index-375.png: headings wrap naturally without collisions.
typography_spacing.weakness: B/lighting-index-1440.png: some captions/footer copy are visually minute relative to the large editorial type.

responsive_composition.strength: B/lighting-collection-375.png: dedicated mobile navigation row and clean card stacking; B/lighting-planner-375.png: full-width inputs and summary are neatly contained.
responsive_composition.weakness: B/lighting-index-375.png: hero support copy and collection link share a narrow two-column row, making the link wrap.

professional_finish.strength: B/lighting-planner-1440.png: carefully framed empty state, aligned form fields and consistent footer; B/lighting-collection-375.png: product/actions rhythm remains orderly.
professional_finish.weakness: B/lighting-planner-375.png: long vertical sequence and duplicated installation imagery reduce compactness.

hierarchy.strength: B/expedition-index-1440.png: serif/italic hero, wide route tile and secondary tiles provide clear visual sequence. B/expedition-builder-1440.png: light builder panel strongly separates controls from itinerary.
hierarchy.weakness: B/expedition-builder-375.png: itinerary comes before the builder, producing a long page before the primary planning controls.

art_direction.strength: B/expedition-index-1440.png: alpine/fjord images, mint accent strip and topographic desert treatment form a coherent editorial system; B/expedition-builder-1440.png: route schematic adds visual specificity.
art_direction.weakness: B/expedition-journeys-375.png: desert artwork loses its designed desktop heading composition on mobile.

typography_spacing.strength: B/expedition-journeys-1440.png: serif intro and bold sans route titles establish clear levels; B/expedition-builder-1440.png: repeated rules organize itinerary and form.
typography_spacing.weakness: B/expedition-builder-375.png: route diagram labels and supporting itinerary metadata are very small; B/expedition-journeys-1440.png: some secondary details are subdued and small within spacious cards.

responsive_composition.strength: B/expedition-index-375.png: mobile navigation has its own row, tiles stack neatly and image crops retain landscape subjects. B/expedition-builder-375.png: planner fields fit cleanly.
responsive_composition.weakness: B/expedition-journeys-375.png: desert illustration heading extends beyond its right edge and is cut off.

professional_finish.strength: B/expedition-builder-1440.png: coordinated illustration, photo, accordion rows and light summary panel provide a finished visual composition.
professional_finish.weakness: B/expedition-journeys-375.png: clipped desert heading is a visible responsive finish defect.

visible_defects.observation: The desert illustration displays its heading as a single long line ('THE OPEN HORIZ...') clipped at the right edge. The desktop counterpart shows the full 'THE OPEN HORIZON' heading in three contained lines.
visible_defects.basis: Visible text clipping; not a subjective preference.
